name: ProgressButton
summary: React button component that shows manual or automatic progress with success and error states, built on the shadcn/ui button.
description: An extended shadcn/ui button that visualizes progress during async actions like file uploads and form submissions. Progress is either manual (a 0-100 prop) or automatic (a duration split into randomized steps), driven by an XState state machine with idle, inProgress, success, successFadeOut and error states; the success color, callbacks and duration are configurable.
contains: manual progress via a progress prop, automatic progress via totalDuration and numberOfProgressSteps
XState states: idle, inProgress, success, successFadeOut, error
success color set with a Tailwind class (successColorClass)
builds on the shadcn/ui button and progress bar
